genre.zh: 戶外探險品牌型錄（Patagonia、國家地理那種）
genre.en: an outdoor-adventure brand catalogue in the manner of Patagonia and National Geographic: real trails and wild places, weather and dirt left in

s: the can rests on a mossy rock at a forest trailhead, hard morning sun cutting through pines, a hiking pack and boots beside it
a gloved hand holds the can at the edge of a mountain trail, low sun from the side, the forest softly behind

the can stands upright on a rough-sawn cedar workbench against a deep forest-green painted plank wall, hard side light from a low window on the left throwing its sharp shadow long across the wood grain, the can filling most of the frame

the can sits on a flat granite boulder at a mountain campsite with a terracotta-orange tent wall behind it, hard late-afternoon sun from the right casting a crisp dark shadow across the rock, the can large in the foreground

a gloved hand clips the can onto the hip belt of a backpack on a trail-side log, a deep-navy rain jacket filling the background, hard low sun from behind throwing a long crisp shadow of the can across the bark, the can big and sharp in frame

the can leans against a rust-red steel toolbox on a forestry work truck tailgate, hard midday sun from above-left carving a clean shadow beneath it, the can taking up most of the frame with the forest softly blurred behind

the can rests on a weathered picnic table at a campsite beside a mint-green enamel camping mug, hard morning sun raking in from the left to cast a long sharp shadow across the planks, the can close and dominant in frame
